scope: Read-only external research; compare archived original probabilities, not Mario's bot. No inference, external messages, models called or purchases. Frozen before examining scored OpenAI rows in this new comparison. Dates partially overlap previously inspected Gemini-vs-Gemma/other-vs-mini cohorts; these are not novel blind test sets for the overall mission.
population: ForecastBench resolved binary data-source targets only (acled, dbnomics, fred, wikipedia, yfinance). No market sources, Metaculus, crowds or peer data. At most one row for source/id/direction/resolution date within due round. Resolution strictly later than the official round due date and no later than 2026-11-24 inclusive. All selected probabilities finite, true native values; reject imputed/missing and inconsistent paired truths. Counts and hashes recorded. No individually timestamped call claims.

panels.early: Five releases from 2026-05-24 through 2026-07-19. Same data targets and non-imputed official naive, Gemini 3.5 Flash, Gemma 4 31B, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5.4-mini. Canonical no-freeze, default model configurations only. Compare each OpenAI Brier vs Gemini and Gemma on identical rows.
panels.middle: Five releases 2026-08-02 through 2026-09-27. Same rows for naive, Gemini 3.5 Flash default, GPT-5.5 default, GPT-5.6 Sol standard medium with web/code. No freeze. Compare 5.6 vs both Gemini and GPT-5.5. Configuration comparison; native web/code differs from untooled competitors. Not a model-only effect.
panels.frontier: From 2026-09-13 through 2026-10-11 inclusive, every same-round no-freeze pairing of Gemini 3.8 Flash high web with each of GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol standard-high-web + official naive. Descriptive cohorts per pair (latest run single-date when necessary). No rank across unequal rows. Tool and effort metadata reported.
panels.oct25: 2026-10-25 has only zero-shot-with-freeze-values. Strict separate panel on common data questions, official naive, Gemini3.8 Flash high-web and every available OpenAI GPT-5.6-Sol/6-Astra/6-Sol/6-Luna/6.1-Sol standard high web (and GPT-5.5 high web if present). Compare scores within this panel; no mixing with incompatible no-freeze rounds.
panels.latest: For GPT-6.2 search the publicly distributed forecast and leaderboard archive/revision for genuine probabilities and later resolutions. If unavailable report no score and its current API price. Never substitute current predictions on old questions.

scoring: Brier loss primary; natural log loss secondary capped only at 1e-6 and 1-1e-6. Gains = comparator loss minus OpenAI loss (<0 worse). Equal row weights; two-sided 95% percentile bootstrap over intact forecast rounds (seed 8824, 16384 draws or exact when <=5 dates). No interval or p-value for a single round. For inference consider all eight planned early/middle Brier contrasts one Holm family against sign-symmetric equally weighted paired round mean changes, one-sided exact sign randomization. Require >=5 dates, Holm p<.05, lower bootstrap >0 and no negative log-loss for an archival screen. Finite few rounds and repeated targets limit independent replications. Also report results deduplicating targets across dates within panel and data-source breakdown. No production promotion.
cost_basis: Report observed token/runtime only if source provides them. Otherwise illustrate 2000 input and 1000 total billable output tokens per forecast, model-specific Standard rates, short context, no cached input. Reasoning, search, hosted code execution, retries, sources and taxes can raise actual costs; tools and harness costs must be separated.
